# Model Viewer

Pinned `@google/model-viewer` 4.0.0 distribution for CoRe3D's interactive GLB examples.

- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@google/model-viewer@4.0.0/dist/model-viewer.min.js
- SHA-256: `774edda21e1be2a0934e460ca5943af1fe3f88da130a9f98bd6a9d611576cacf`
- Package license: [LICENSE](LICENSE); bundled dependency notices remain in the distributed module.

The standalone module is served locally. CoRe3D's eight GLBs contain their geometry and do not require external geometry decoders.
